camrotate.config.title: Camrotate Settings
camrotate.config.mod_enabled.tooltip: Turns Camrotate on or off completely.
camrotate.config.only_first_person.toolt: Only rotate your body to match the camera while in first-person view.
camrotate.config.riding_rotation_type.to: Normal uses Minecraft's default rotation while riding. Always Follow uses Camrotate's rotation even while riding. [ WARNING: 'Always Follow' Rotation might break how you look to other players ]
